precepts.text: Turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
precepts.point: The Lord is not slack but longsuffering, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
What is the promise the Lord is not slack about? Go up to verse 3: scoffers come in the last days “saying, Where is the promise of his coming?” The promise is that this place will burn like an oven. It is coming one way or the other. No man knows the day or the hour, but trust and believe it is coming. The scoffers are all over TikTok and YouTube; the apologetics and the black Christians walk after their own lusts and their slave master's doctrine.

But the Lord “is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.” That is what the Lord wants: all to come to repentance. Ezekiel shows his heart: “Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live”. The wicked here are the wicked of our people.

Then, “turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?” Turning from your wicked ways is repentance. That is why the fire has not come yet: God is holding back so the house of Israel can turn and live. The question is what we have to do to escape what is coming, and the answer is here. Our help is in the name of the Lord, and that name is God's commandments with faith in his Son.

precepts.text: Many hear the word as a lovely song, loving to hear the scriptures broken down, but they hear the words and do them not; hearing so much does not earn you credit for doing.
precepts.point: That thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: the end goal of talking about the commandments and meditating on the commandments is to do the commandments. Attending every class, hearing every breakdown, and keeping every precept list is all in vain if you never do thus saith the Lord; not doing the word of God is why we went into slavery and sit at the bottom of society.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
“that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein”: the end goal of talking about the commandments and meditating on the commandments is to do the commandments. Ezekiel shows the people who never get there: “And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.”

“And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.” Many hear the word as a lovely song, loving to hear the scriptures broken down, but they hear the words and do them not. Hearing so much does not earn you credit for doing. Attending every class, hearing every breakdown, and keeping every precept list is all in vain if you never do thus saith the Lord.

note.label: The God Of Israel Is The God Of Mercy

precepts.why: They will know a prophet was among them. “Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets”: he sends us to wake you up, to let you know what to look out for, how to carry yourself in this walk and stay ten toes down in this truth. “Rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.” We warn you: don’t do the things God hates, the things that piss God off. Don’t be murmuring, don’t be out there in idolatry, fornication or adultery, don’t be running around lying. Build your spirit and your mind up. Have a true forgiveness for your brothers and sisters in the truth, so you can grow and the Lord can use you as a good vessel.

A precept for watch. “But if the watchman see the sword come”: you see danger and judgment coming, “and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come”: the war, the danger, “and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.” The watchmen are the men teaching the Bible: God will require it at our hand if we saw the danger coming and said nothing. We have been warning for years that there would be infiltrations in the congregations to cause confusion.

“So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.” We are watchmen to the house of Israel, and this class is another warning.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

precepts.why:
The answer to how should we then live: “Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?” The Most High is asking: I gave y’all everything; y’all bring this upon yourself. You’re suffering because of your own sin. Why would you die, Israel? Why would you continue to be degenerate and pine away?

“For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth”: that’s the merciful one, being merciful to his inheritance. He has no pleasure in you dying in your sins. “Wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.” So, Israel, let’s turn away from these sins, these idols, and let’s live unto the Most High in Christ.

note.label: The God Of Israel Is The God Of Mercy

points: “And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument”: when we bring out the scriptures it is like a lovely song to them, like Luther Vandross or somebody who can sing real good. “For they hear thy words, but they do them not”: they hear what the Bible says but don’t want to change. That is how Israel is: you hear what the Bible says, but you refuse to make any changes.

note.label: The God Of Israel Is The God Of Mercy

points: The things written before time were written for our learning, and these same people are back on the earth today with fringes and borders of blue on. “And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,)”: it is going to happen, and today is the day they are back again. “Then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them”: because we are warning you to stay away from idiots, from people who are not motivating or moving your spirit, people dragging you down spiritually. Spiritual vampires; the Bishop calls it STD, spiritually transmitted demons. Stay away from them, uplift your spirit and build your mind through the scriptures. That is what we are here for. You will know a prophet was among you, because we are telling you what is happening now and what to stay away from.

note.label: The God Of Israel Is The God Of Mercy

points: “So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.” If the watchman does not warn the wicked, “that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.” But if he warns him and “he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.” As a watchman, you’ve done your job. If they don’t want to listen, if they don’t want to hearken, it is what it is.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

points: “If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?” To pine is to lose vigor, health or flesh. That’s what we did: we lost our boldness, we lost our integrity, we lost all of that to the point where we were withered away. We were degenerate.
How should we then live? What’s our only option, brothers and sisters? Christ. That’s the only way. If we didn’t have Christ, we would all have died off.
